title: I'm planning a new home
content: ABC Design works with clients to transform an idea for a new home into clear, permit-ready construction drawings. From the initial layout through coordination with engineers and consultants, the plans are prepared to support permitting, communication, and construction.
rickInput: At what stage do clients usually contact you?
What makes your approach to new-home design different?
What types of homes or residential developments should be mentioned?

title: I'm remodeling my home
content: Whether the project involves an addition, interior reconfiguration, whole-home renovation, or structural changes, ABC Design begins by understanding how the space needs to function. The resulting construction documents are prepared to reflect the project goals and the requirements of permitting and construction.

title: I'm adding an ADU
content: ABC Design prepares plans for attached and detached ADUs, garage conversions, and other accessory dwelling projects. Each project is developed with attention to the existing property, local requirements, consultant coordination, and the information needed for permit review.

title: I'm improving my property
content: Not every project involves a new building or major remodel. ABC Design also prepares drawings for retaining walls, garages, accessory structures, site improvements, outdoor structures, and other property improvements that require professional construction documents.

title: I'm developing a commercial space
content: ABC Design prepares construction drawings for restaurants, retail spaces, offices, tenant improvements, and other commercial projects. These projects often require careful coordination among the client, engineers, consultants, contractors, landlords, and reviewing agencies.
rickInput: What types of commercial spaces have you worked on?
What do commercial clients most often need help navigating?

title: I'm planning a larger development
content: ABC Design also supports larger and more complex work, including multi-unit residential projects, commercial developments, business parks, and multi-building sites. These projects require organized documentation, careful coordination, and an experienced understanding of how the parts of a development fit together.

title: I need permit-ready construction drawings
content: Some clients already have a concept, sketch, or general direction and need a professional drawing set prepared for permit submittal and construction. ABC Design develops coordinated documents that clearly communicate the proposed work to reviewing agencies, consultants, and contractors.
rickInput: What does a typical permit drawing set include?

title: I'm responding to plan check comments
content: Plan check comments are a normal part of many permitting processes. ABC Design can revise construction documents, coordinate responses with engineers and consultants, and prepare updated drawings for resubmittal so the project can continue moving through review.
rickInput: Do you take over projects that were originally drawn by someone else?
What types of plan check comments are most common?

title: I need project management support
content: For select projects, ABC Design can remain involved beyond the drawing and permitting phases. Project management support may include consultant coordination, communication during construction, document clarification, and assistance keeping the work aligned with the approved plans.
